---
title: "About"
---

Radyssey is a free set of interactive lessons for radiology residents, written by Hasan, a fellow radiology resident.

Every lesson is hands-on. Some take one real image and teach a technique on it step by step, with overlays you can drag, sliders and a short self-test. Others are larger atlases, with 3D anatomy, simulators and a question bank. The lessons work in a phone browser and need no sign-up. Your progress stays in your own browser.

**How the lessons are made**

- Images and models are openly licensed (for example CC BY or CC BY-SA) and credited on the page, or made by the author. No patient data is used.
- Facts are cited to their sources: papers, guidelines, or standard textbooks with page numbers. Textbook text and figures are not reproduced. Teaching points that were not checked against a source are marked "general knowledge".
- There are no ads and no tracking.

**Feedback.** Corrections and requests for topics are welcome.

*For education only, not clinical advice. The lessons are study aids and do not replace supervised training or local protocols.*
